              The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to developmental psychology. This course focuses on individual development from infants to late adolescence. Specific topics will include: attachment, theory of mind, intelligence, and application of developmental psychology into the society.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course is mostly consisted of lectures on the basic knowledge of developmental psychology. However, there are several chances in each class that students actively engage into the learning contexts. Additionally, every last 15 minutes are spent for quiz of the learning context. Thus, students are required to focus on the learning contents and acquire most of the basic knowledge during the course.
This course is subject to the course credit system.
